headings.reviewNote: Prohibits stretcher vans from transporting patients admitted to hospitals or individuals requiring emergency treatment.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for stretcher van standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to promulgate regulations governing vehicle staffing, safety, equipment, and insurance.

headings.title: Five-year license term for compliant services
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of stretcher van service licenses for terms of up to five years.

headings.title: Application procedures and pre-licensure inspections
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes department application requirements and mandatory vehicle inspections for stretcher van licensing.

headings.title: Ownership transfer notification and inspection requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days advance notice of ownership transfer and mandatory re-inspection by the department.

headings.title: Licensed ambulance services authorized to operate stretcher vans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes licensed ambulance services to operate stretcher van and wheelchair transportation services.

headings.title: Rulemaking compliance and nonseverability provisions
headings.reviewNote: Conditions department rulemaking authority under this section on chapter 536 and section 536.028 compliance and establishes nonseverability for rules after August 28, 2002.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes licensing, equipment, staffing, and passenger safety standards for stretcher van services while restricting emergency medical transports.

headings.title: Refusal to issue or renew stretcher van license
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes department refusal or non-renewal of stretcher van licenses and sets administrative hearing notice rights.

headings.title: Grounds for disciplinary complaints against licensees
headings.reviewNote: Specifies misconduct, fraud, unlawful substance use, and criminal conviction grounds for disciplinary complaints.

headings.title: Administrative hearing proceedings and disciplinary sanctions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes administrative hearing procedures and department authority to censure, place on probation, suspend, or revoke licenses.

headings.title: Waiting period and conditions for relicensure following revocation
headings.reviewNote: Imposes a one-year waiting period following license revocation before reapplying for licensure.

headings.title: Out-of-state disciplinary notification authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to notify licensing authorities in other states regarding suspension or revocation.

headings.title: Immunity for good faith reporting of violations
headings.reviewNote: Shields individuals and entities reporting information to the department in good faith and without negligence under sections 190.525 to 190.537 from civil damages.

headings.title: Immediate emergency license suspension for imminent health threats
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes simultaneous summary suspension of licenses upon findings of imminent public health threats and sets appeal timelines.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs license refusal, disciplinary grounds, administrative hearings, sanctions, and emergency suspensions for stretcher van service operators.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for stretcher van violations
headings.reviewNote: Designates noncompliance with stretcher van statutory provisions as a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Separate daily offenses and stay of cumulation
headings.reviewNote: Classifies each day of continuing violation as a separate offense and authorizes court stays of penalty cumulation.

headings.title: Concurrent enforcement jurisdiction and injunctive relief
headings.reviewNote: Grants concurrent jurisdiction to the attorney general and local prosecutors to seek criminal penalties and injunctive relief.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes criminal penalties, cumulative daily violations, and concurrent prosecutor and attorney general injunctive enforcement authority for stretcher van statutory violations.

headings.title: Rulemaking for fee schedules and volunteer exemption
headings.reviewNote: Directs department rulemaking to establish licensure and accreditation fee schedules while exempting volunteer ambulance personnel.

headings.title: Public health services fund deposit and nonreversion
headings.reviewNote: Requires fees to be deposited in the public health services fund for statutory implementation without biennial reversion.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs promulgation of fee schedules for emergency medical and stretcher van licensure and mandates fee deposit into the dedicated public health services fund.

headings.title: Short title of act
headings.reviewNote: Designates sections 190.600 to 190.621 as the Outside the Hospital Do-Not-Resuscitate Act.

headings.title: Definitions for outside hospital do-not-resuscitate
headings.reviewNote: Defines attending physician, CPR, EMS personnel, health care facility, and related statutory terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the title and statutory definitions for the Outside the Hospital Do-Not-Resuscitate Act.

headings.title: Execution of outside hospital do-not-resuscitate order
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes execution of outside the hospital DNR orders by patients or representatives and attending physicians.

headings.title: Minors and surrogate authorization under court order
headings.reviewNote: Governs execution of DNR orders on behalf of minors by parents, guardians, or courts.

headings.title: Placement in patient medical records
headings.reviewNote: Requires an executed outside the hospital DNR order to be maintained as the first page of a patient's health care facility medical record unless otherwise specified in facility policies and procedures.

headings.title: Transfer of order with patient
headings.reviewNote: Mandates transferring DNR orders alongside patients between health care facilities or providers.

entries.reviewSummary: Regulates execution, minor authorization, medical record placement, and transfer of outside the hospital do-not-resuscitate orders.

headings.title: Limitation to outside hospital settings
headings.reviewNote: Limits effectiveness of outside the hospital DNR orders to non-hospital settings.

headings.title: Preservation of comfort care and pain alleviation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits withholding comfort care, pain management, or medical interventions other than CPR.

headings.title: Suspension during pregnancy and good faith immunity
headings.reviewNote: Suspends DNR orders during pregnancy and provides immunity for good faith actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Restricts outside the hospital DNR orders to non-hospital environments, preserves comfort care, and addresses pregnancy exceptions and immunity.

headings.title: EMS personnel compliance and patient revocation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes emergency medical services personnel compliance with DNR protocols unless resuscitation is requested.

headings.title: Compliance for minors and revocation of minor orders
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes compliance with section 191.250 minor DNR orders but bars compliance if the minor patient, either parent, legal guardian, or juvenile or family court expresses a desire for resuscitation.

headings.title: Facility transfer upon refusal to comply
headings.reviewNote: Requires unwilling physicians or health care facilities to take reasonable steps to transfer patients.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs emergency medical services compliance with DNR orders, revocation by patients or surrogates, and patient transfer duties.

headings.title: Recognition of out-of-state orders and forms
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes execution of DNR orders through recognized out-of-state DNR or TPOPP and POLST forms.

headings.title: Requirements and restrictions for out-of-state forms
headings.reviewNote: Sets department review requirements, minor restrictions, pregnancy limits, and revocation rights for out-of-state forms.

headings.title: Immunity for emergency medical services personnel
headings.reviewNote: Extends statutory good faith liability protections to EMS personnel acting under this section.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes recognition of out-of-state do-not-resuscitate orders and portable medical orders, establishing departmental compliance standards and immunity.

headings.title: Death under order not suicide or homicide
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that death resulting from withholding CPR under a DNR order is not suicide or homicide.

headings.title: Effect of order on life insurance
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits DNR orders from impairing, invalidating, or modifying terms of life insurance policies.

headings.title: Prohibition on conditioning services on order execution
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits health care providers and insurers from requiring DNR orders as a condition of service or coverage.

headings.title: Cumulative rights of patients preserved
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory DNR provisions do not prejudice independent patient rights to direct medical care.

headings.title: Mercy killing and euthanasia prohibited
headings.reviewNote: Affirms that DNR provisions do not authorize mercy killing, euthanasia, or deliberate acts to end life.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes legal effects of outside the hospital DNR orders regarding death classification, insurance validity, patient rights, and prohibition of euthanasia.

headings.title: Department rulemaking deadline for DNR protocols
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to promulgate rules for DNR protocols, identifications, and forms by June 30, 2008.

headings.title: Administrative procedure compliance and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Conditions rulemaking authority on compliance with chapter 536 and establishes nonseverability.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates department rulemaking for outside the hospital DNR protocols, forms, and identification, with administrative compliance provisions.

headings.title: Misdemeanor penalty for concealing order or falsifying revocation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a class A misdemeanor for knowingly concealing, canceling, defacing, or obliterating another's DNR order or ID without consent, or falsifying or forging a revocation.

headings.title: Felony penalty for forging order or concealing revocation
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a class E felony for knowingly executing, falsifying, or forging another's DNR order or ID without consent, or concealing or withholding personal knowledge of a revocation.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes criminal penalties for defacing, falsifying, forging, or concealing outside the hospital do-not-resuscitate orders or revocations.

headings.title: Imposition of ambulance reimbursement allowance tax
headings.reviewNote: Imposes an ambulance service reimbursement allowance tax on ground ambulance services for business privilege.

headings.title: Definitions for ambulance reimbursement allowance
headings.reviewNote: Defines ambulance, ambulance service, and engaging in business for reimbursement allowance purposes.

entries.reviewSummary: Imposes a reimbursement allowance tax on ground ambulance services and provides statutory definitions; source notes indicate expiration on September 30, 2029 under section 190.839.

headings.title: Formula for ambulance service reimbursement allowance
headings.reviewNote: Requires the reimbursement allowance formula to be established by rule and consistent with federal regulations.

headings.title: Jurisdiction for legal challenges to rules
headings.reviewNote: Designates the circuit court of Cole County as having original jurisdiction for legal challenges to reimbursement rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the regulatory formula for ambulance reimbursement allowances under federal health care tax rules and assigns original jurisdiction for rule challenges to Cole County Circuit Court; source notes indicate expiration on September 30, 2029 under section 190.839.

headings.title: Determination of reimbursement allowance tax amount
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director of social services to determine the reimbursement allowance tax owed by each ambulance service.

headings.title: Annual notification and monthly payment options
headings.reviewNote: Mandates annual tax notification by October first and permits monthly installment payments.

headings.title: Offset against MO HealthNet payments authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes offsetting reimbursement allowance taxes against MO HealthNet payments upon ambulance service request.

headings.title: Quarterly tax rate adjustments and criteria
headings.reviewNote: Permits quarterly prospective rate adjustments and individualized adjustments for substantial service characteristic changes.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs determination, annual notification, installment payments, MO HealthNet offsets, and quarterly adjustments of ambulance reimbursement allowance taxes; source notes indicate expiration on September 30, 2029 under section 190.839.

headings.title: Finality of tax determination and protest period
headings.reviewNote: Makes tax determinations final unless an ambulance service files a protest within thirty days of notice.

headings.title: Protest hearings and administrative appeals
headings.reviewNote: Provides for director reconsideration hearings and subsequent appeals to the administrative hearing commission.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes protest deadlines, director reconsideration hearings, and Administrative Hearing Commission appeals for ambulance reimbursement allowance tax determinations; source notes indicate expiration on September 30, 2029 under section 190.839.

headings.title: Remittance of tax and fund establishment
headings.reviewNote: Directs tax remittances to the department of revenue for deposit into the dedicated Ambulance Service Reimbursement Allowance Fund.

headings.title: Satisfaction of tax obligation by payment or offset
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that valid fund payments or authorized offsets fully satisfy the ambulance service tax obligation.

headings.title: State treasurer fund records and department disclosure
headings.reviewNote: Requires the state treasurer to maintain fund balance and investment earnings records and requires the department of social services to disclose them upon written request.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the Ambulance Service Reimbursement Allowance Fund, regulating tax remittances, investment earnings, nonreversion, and fund accounting disclosures; source notes indicate expiration on September 30, 2029 under section 190.839.

headings.title: Tax period dates and delinquency notices
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the annual October first to September thirtieth tax period and sets delinquency notice timelines.

headings.title: Lien enforcement and Medicaid agreement remedies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes circuit court lien enforcement and denial of MO HealthNet participation agreements for delinquent taxes.

headings.title: License denial, suspension, or revocation grounds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ambulance service license denial, suspension, or revocation for failure to pay delinquent taxes.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines the October-to-September reimbursement allowance tax period, delinquency timelines, circuit court lien enforcement, MO HealthNet agreement sanctions, and licensure sanctions; source notes indicate expiration on September 30, 2029 under section 190.839.

headings.title: Enactment of interstate EMS personnel compact
headings.reviewNote: Enacts and enters into the Recognition of EMS Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact (REPLICA) with member jurisdictions.

headings.title: Definitions for interstate EMS compact
headings.reviewNote: Defines adverse action, certification, commission, home state, member state, privilege to practice, and related terms.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Recognition of EMS Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact and defines foundational statutory terms.

headings.title: Home state status for licensed personnel
headings.reviewNote: Designates any member state where an individual holds an active license as a home state.

headings.title: Independent state licensing authority preserved
headings.reviewNote: Preserves member state authority to require state licenses under circumstances outside compact privileges.

headings.title: Prerequisites for home state practice privileges
headings.reviewNote: Sets home state examination, complaint investigation, adverse action reporting, and criminal background check requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes home state licensure criteria and mandatory regulatory prerequisites required to extend interstate practice privileges.

headings.title: Mutual recognition of practice privileges
headings.reviewNote: Requires member states to recognize the privilege to practice of individuals licensed in qualifying member states.

headings.title: Individual eligibility criteria for practice privilege
headings.reviewNote: Requires individuals to be eighteen, hold an unrestricted license, and practice under a medical director.

headings.title: Scope of practice in remote states
headings.reviewNote: Requires individuals to practice within the home state scope of practice unless modified by the remote state.

headings.title: Subjection to remote state authority and laws
headings.reviewNote: Subjects individuals practicing in remote states to local laws, disciplinary authority, and reporting mandates.

headings.title: Ineligibility upon home state license restriction
headings.reviewNote: Precludes remote compact practice whenever an individual home state license is restricted or revoked.

headings.title: Ineligibility upon remote state privilege restriction
headings.reviewNote: Precludes practice in any remote state whenever an individual privilege is restricted in any remote state.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs interstate recognition of emergency medical practice privileges, individual qualifications, and remote state scope of practice limits.

headings.title: Military credentials satisfying licensure standards
headings.reviewNote: Recognizes active military, veteran, and National Guard NREMT credentials as meeting minimum state licensing requirements.

headings.title: Expedited application processing for military personnel
headings.reviewNote: Requires member states to expedite licensure applications for military service members, veterans, and spouses.

headings.title: Adverse action applicability to military practitioners
headings.reviewNote: Maintains applicability of compact adverse action provisions to individuals practicing under military reciprocity.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes expedited licensure processes and credential recognition for military personnel, veterans, and military spouses under the compact.

headings.title: Exclusive home state adverse action authority
headings.reviewNote: Grants home states exclusive power to take adverse action against licenses issued by the home state.

headings.title: Interstate effect of home state license restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Inactivates remote compact privileges whenever an individual home state license is restricted or suspended.

headings.title: Adverse action reporting to commission
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reporting of all adverse actions and privilege restrictions to the interstate commission.

headings.title: Remote state authority over local practice privileges
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes remote states to take adverse action against an individual privilege to practice locally.

headings.title: Adverse actions based on other states findings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes member states to impose adverse actions based on factual findings of other member states.

headings.title: Home state coordination of remote conduct investigations
headings.reviewNote: Requires home state EMS authorities to coordinate investigations and apply home state law to remote conduct.

headings.title: Alternative programs in lieu of adverse action
headings.reviewNote: Preserves state authority to utilize confidential alternative programs and restricts interstate practice during participation.

entries.reviewSummary: Delineates home and remote state authority regarding adverse actions, reporting duties, multi-state coordination, and alternative recovery programs.

headings.title: Establishment of Interstate Commission for EMS Personnel
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Interstate Commission for EMS Personnel Practice as a joint public instrumentality of member states.

headings.title: Commission delegate representation and meeting procedures
headings.reviewNote: Provides for one delegate per member state, voting rights, open public meetings, and closed meeting exceptions.

headings.title: Bylaws and governance rule promulgation
headings.reviewNote: Directs adoption of bylaws and procedural rules governing meetings, officers, personnel policies, and financial records.

headings.title: Powers of the interstate commission
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates commission powers including uniform rulemaking, litigation, property management, personnel hiring, and committee appointments.

headings.title: Commission financing, Missouri assessment cap, and annual audits
headings.reviewNote: Regulates commission expenses, donations, annual assessments (capping Missouri at $10,000 annually without CPI increases), debt limits, and mandatory annual CPA audits.

headings.title: Qualified immunity, defense, and indemnification of officials
headings.reviewNote: Provides civil immunity, legal defense, and indemnification for commission members, officers, and employees.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Interstate Commission for EMS Personnel Practice, outlining delegate representation, powers, bylaws, financing, and official immunity.

headings.title: Development of coordinated interstate database
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to develop and maintain a coordinated database of licensure and investigatory records.

headings.title: Mandatory uniform data submission by states
headings.reviewNote: Requires member states to submit uniform licensee identifiers, adverse actions, and denials to the database.

headings.title: Prompt notification of adverse actions
headings.reviewNote: Directs the database administrator to notify all member states promptly of adverse actions and significant investigations.

headings.title: Confidentiality designation for contributing states
headings.reviewNote: Permits contributing member states to designate database information that may not be released to the public.

headings.title: Expungement of information upon state mandate
headings.reviewNote: Requires removal of coordinated database records when expungement is mandated by contributing state laws.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs development and maintenance of a coordinated interstate EMS licensure and disciplinary database and regulates data sharing and expungement.

headings.title: Commission rulemaking authority and binding effect
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission rulemaking and establishes the binding effect of promulgated rules across member states.

headings.title: Legislative rejection of rules by majority
headings.reviewNote: Invalidates commission rules upon rejection by a majority of member state legislatures through statute or resolution.

headings.title: Rule adoption at regular or special meetings
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that compact rules and amendments shall be adopted during regular or special commission meetings.

headings.title: Advance notice of proposed rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Mandates public posting of proposed rules at least sixty days prior to commission voting meetings.

headings.title: Contents of proposed rulemaking notice
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes required information in rulemaking notices including meeting dates, rule text, and comment procedures.

headings.title: Public submission of written comments
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to accept and publicly share written comments prior to rule adoption.

headings.title: Thresholds for mandatory public hearings
headings.reviewNote: Requires a public hearing upon request by twenty-five persons, a governmental agency, or an association.

headings.title: Procedures and testimony at public hearings
headings.reviewNote: Regulates hearing notices, advance requests to speak, oral testimony fairness, and recording costs.

headings.title: Consideration of public comments prior to action
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to consider all oral and written public testimony following scheduled hearings.

headings.title: Final commission action by majority vote
headings.reviewNote: Directs final rulemaking action and effective date determinations by majority vote of commission members.

headings.title: Promulgation without hearing in absence of requests
headings.reviewNote: Permits rule promulgation without a public hearing if no written requests to testify are submitted.

headings.title: Emergency rulemaking procedures and criteria
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes immediate adoption of emergency rules to meet imminent public health threats or statutory deadlines.

headings.title: Technical corrections to promulgated rules
headings.reviewNote: Establishes expedited notice and challenge procedures for nonsubstantive typographical and clerical rule revisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes administrative procedures for commission rulemaking, public notice, hearings, emergency rules, and technical corrections.

headings.title: State enforcement of compact and rules
headings.reviewNote: Directs executive, legislative, and judicial branches in member states to enforce compact provisions with statutory standing.

headings.title: Mandatory judicial notice of compact and rules
headings.reviewNote: Requires all courts to take judicial notice of the compact and promulgated rules in member-state judicial or administrative proceedings affecting commission powers or actions.

headings.title: Commission service of process and intervention standing
headings.reviewNote: Grants the commission standing to intervene in judicial proceedings and voids judgments without service of process.

headings.title: Notice and technical assistance for defaults
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice of default and remedial technical assistance to noncompliant member states.

headings.title: Termination of membership for uncured default
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes termination of defaulting member states by majority vote after failure to cure defaults.

headings.title: Exhaustion of remedies and termination notice
headings.reviewNote: Conditions membership termination on exhaustion of remedies and requires formal notice to state legislative leaders.

headings.title: Continuing financial liability of terminated states
headings.reviewNote: Maintains financial assessments and incurred liabilities against states following compact termination.

headings.title: Commission costs during state default
headings.reviewNote: Relieves the commission from bearing costs associated with defaulting or terminated member states.

headings.title: Judicial appeal of termination by defaulting state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes defaulting states to petition federal district courts to challenge commission termination orders.

headings.title: Commission dispute resolution between states
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to facilitate dispute resolution between member states or between member and nonmember states.

headings.title: Mediation and binding dispute resolution rules
headings.reviewNote: Mandates promulgation of procedural rules providing for mediation and binding resolution of compact disputes.

headings.title: Discretionary commission enforcement authority
headings.reviewNote: Empowers the commission to exercise reasonable discretion in enforcing compact provisions and rules.

headings.title: Federal court legal action for compliance
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission federal court lawsuits for injunctive relief, damages, and attorney fees against defaulting states.

headings.title: Cumulative and nonexclusive remedies
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that statutory compact enforcement remedies are nonexclusive of other state and federal remedies.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs state compliance, commission oversight, default and termination procedures, dispute resolution, and federal judicial enforcement.

headings.title: Effective date upon enactment by tenth state
headings.reviewNote: Sets compact implementation upon enactment by the tenth member state for assembly and rulemaking powers; source note records the tenth state enacted REPLICA on May 8, 2017.

headings.title: Subsequent member state accession to rules
headings.reviewNote: Binds newly joining member states to all rules existing on the date of compact enactment.

headings.title: State withdrawal procedure and effective date
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes member state withdrawal upon six months statutory notice without relieving reporting duties.

headings.title: Preservation of nonconflicting cooperative agreements
headings.reviewNote: Maintains validity of bilateral licensure and cooperative agreements that do not conflict with the compact.

headings.title: Unanimous state enactment of compact amendments
headings.reviewNote: Requires enactment by all member states before any compact amendment becomes effective.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes effective date thresholds, rule accession rules, withdrawal processes, cooperative agreements, and amendment requirements.

headings.title: Liberal construction and agency licensing preservation
headings.reviewNote: Requires liberal statutory construction, preserves severability, and clarifies non-preemption of state agency licensing.

headings.title: State advisory council review and cost monitoring
headings.reviewNote: Directs the state advisory council to review commission decisions and permits it to recommend withdrawal to the general assembly if an approved action increases state membership costs.

entries.reviewSummary: Provides rules for liberal statutory construction and severability, and directs advisory council review of compact membership costs.
